text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, damn it, this isn't working at 
all... How're you even supposed to 
practice being honest in the first place?

"Practice being honest"... Those words 
brought to mind the advice Tamamo Cross 
gave regarding a gift for Super Creek.

In order to "give back the same thing she 
received," she must have thought about 
expressing her honest feelings. Thinking 
about her efforts—
choice_data_list: Could I help with that practice?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What? That's none of your business... 
Wait, did you... hear everything?
choice_data_list:
Sorry, you looked like you were struggling 
with it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Like hell I wa— Ugh, seriously...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Fine, yeah, I'm struggling! So what?! Are 
you saying you're gonna help me out or 
something?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that is why you are practicing 
being honest. However... that is quite a 
daunting challenge.
choice_data_list:
I figured her closest friends would make 
the best practice partners.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Closest... friends!! Closest!! You really 
thought of us like that, Taishin! I'm so 
hapbeeee!! Taishin, Taishiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, shut up already...! If we're doing 
this, let's just get it over with.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Honesty is also about expressing one's 
true self outward fully. ...Therefore, 
here is my plan! Created with reference to 
countless quiz books—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Hayahide's Special! Answer with Honesty!! 
True-or-False Quiz for You"!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, question one— 'You have 
attempted the mega-portion set meal in the 
cafeteria before. True or False?'

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I was just hungry, okay............

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Taking on challenges is important, 
but overexerting yourself is not good. 
Next time you take it on, invite us as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Next, question two. 'You deliberately head 
out to train during time slots when fewer 
girls are around. True or False?'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I will not say it is bad, but it would be 
terrible if something were to happen. When 
you need to ask for help, be sure to do so 
properly. Next—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wait... How many more questions of these 
lectures do I have to listen to...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm next! Ta-daaa! It's a cat cafe!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Because Taishin... wants to talk to cats!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you even saying...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I know all about it! There's a cat you're 
friends with in the alley behind the 
shopping district! And you always say 
stuff like, "Looking energetic, huh"!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But whenever someone gets close, you stop! 
Even though you really want to talk to 
cats... Taishin, you can't be honest 
whenever someone's watching!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-When did you even see that?! —I mean, 
that was just, like... t-talking to myself 
or something...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Urrgh!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Taishin. Commune with the cat with 
your honest feelings...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: My... honest feelings are............

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I CAN'T DO THIS ANYMORE!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Staying 'honest' any longer than this 
is... toootally impossible! I can't take 
it! Idiots!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. At last, we have heard a 
heartfelt, honest opinion.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Were the things you received from 
Creek-san given through anguish and 
painful overexertion?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I thought it would be dangerous if 
they tore, so I patched them up during my 
break~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Right now is a ve~ry important time for me 
too, so I wanted us to do our best 
together, you see♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(...I see... Conveying my unvarnished 
feelings. ...That was all I needed to 
do...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a second. You already knew that, 
and still made me go through all of that?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
'Cause we almost never get to see you 
being this honest, Taishin! Right, 
Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Why, you little............!
choice_data_list: You've got great friends, don't you?

Next time let's make the two of them be 
honest!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Why, you little............!
choice_data_list: You've got great friends, don't you?

Next time let's make the two of them be 
honest!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Great where...?! After messing with me 
this whole time... just because they 
dropped a nice line at the end... gh!
choice_data_list:
Still, thanks to them, you realized 
something important, right?

Still, thanks to them, you realized 
something important, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's—... Well, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Taishin...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Just. That. Much...! Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Aahh. Well said, then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
All right, Hayahide. Let me ask you a 
question. Answer honestly with True or 
False.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"You believe today's hair styling turned 
out well. True or False?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What?! C-Could it be that it didn't turn 
out well...?!
